fix: triet de loai bo bieu thuc param IS NULL trong PositionAssignmentRepository de tranh loi PostgreSQL type inference

- Nguyen nhan van bi loi tren FE:
  O commit truoc, mac du da bo ':excludeId IS NULL', nhung trong cau query
  van con bieu thuc ':from IS NULL' va ':to IS NULL'.
  Hibernate khi dich ra SQL da tao ra tham so positional rieng biet
  (vi du: ? IS NULL OR pa.effective_to >= ?), khien PostgreSQL JDBC van tiep
  tuc qu─âng ngoai le 'PSQLException: could not determine data type of parameter'
  cho tham so dung trong '? IS NULL'.

- Giai phap triet de:
  1. Tach thanh 4 query ro rang:
     - existsOverlappingWithTo: tao moi co thoi han (to != null)
     - existsOverlappingOpenEnded: tao moi vo thoi han (to == null)
     - existsOverlappingWithToExcluding: cap nhat co thoi han (to != null, excludeId != null)
     - existsOverlappingOpenEndedExcluding: cap nhat vo thoi han (to == null, excludeId != null)
  2. Toan bo tham so (:userId, :from, :to, :excludeId) deu duoc so sanh truc
     tiep voi cac cot entity tuong ung, khong con bat ky menh de '? IS NULL'
     nao danh cho tham so.
  3. Cap nhat integration test PositionAssignmentRepositoryTest kiem tra du 4 case.

fix(dast): treat ZAP exit code 2 (warning-only) as success (#65)

* fix(deploy): keep the Heroku image in Docker schema2 format

The Heroku container registry started rejecting our image with
"error from registry: unsupported" - every layer is pushed successfully, only the
manifest upload is refused.

Root cause (verified by diffing the log of the last successful run with the
failing ones):

  run 39269562920 (19/10, success, runner ubuntu-24.04)
    #16 writing image sha256:16448b85... done          -> Docker schema2 manifest

  run 39627810818 (21/10, failure, runner ubuntu-26.04)
    #16 exporting manifest sha256:e898b423... done     -> OCI manifest
    #16 exporting attestation manifest sha256:3618cbe... done

`ubuntu-latest` migrated to Ubuntu 26.04 (runner-image release 20261018.168),
whose Docker uses the containerd image store and therefore exports an OCI
manifest with an attestation manifest. The Heroku container registry only
accepts a plain Docker schema2 manifest.

Fix:
- pin the deploy job to ubuntu-24.04 (runner-image 20261012.334, Docker 28.0.4
  / Buildx 0.38.0) - the exact environment that produced a working push
- disable the default buildx attestations (--provenance=false --sbom=false) so
  no attestation manifest is emitted

* fix(security): add CSP/HSTS/Permissions-Policy headers + map MethodArgumentTypeMismatch to 400

- SecurityConfig: add headers block with
  - HSTS (max-age=31536000, includeSubDomains)
  - CSP (default-src 'self' with Swagger-friendly directives)
  - Permissions-Policy (camera=(), microphone=(), geolocation=())
  Resolves 3 of the 7 OWASP ZAP baseline WARN (CSP, HSTS, Permissions-Policy).
- GlobalExceptionHandler: add @ExceptionHandler for MethodArgumentTypeMismatchException
  -> 400 BAD_REQUEST instead of falling through to the generic 500 handler.
  This fixes the finding observed during the authenticated DAST scan where
  GET /api/v1/documents/pending and /api/v1/documents/statistics returned
  HTTP 500 ("Lß╗ùi hß╗ç thß╗æng") for a non-numeric {id} path variable.

* fix(dast): treat ZAP exit code 2 (warning-only) as success; the pipeline gate stays the authority

fix(dast): resilient authenticated ZAP scan + valid OpenAPI 3.1 license identifier (#62)

* fix(dast): make the authenticated ZAP scan resilient + valid OpenAPI 3.1 doc

The first authenticated DAST run aborted in the openapi job: one endpoint read
timed out and the parser rejected the definition, so with failOnError the plan
stopped before spider/activeScan and produced no report at all.

- .zap/zap-jwt-config.yaml
  - failOnError: false + continueOnFailure: true so a single flaky endpoint
    cannot abort the scan; the pipeline gate stays the authority
  - passiveScan-config: scanOnlyInContext -> scanOnlyInScope (correct param)
  - passiveScan-wait: maxDuration 5 -> 1 (the param is in minutes)
  - new export job writing the reached URL list (scanned_urls.txt) as evidence
- pipeline-4-dast-scan.yml
  - gate now also fails when the scan reached fewer than 10 URLs, so a run that
    silently authenticated nothing cannot look like a clean scan
- OpenApiConfig: add info.license.identifier, which OpenAPI 3.1 requires next
  to info.license.name (strict parsers such as ZAP rejected the whole doc)

* fix(dast): export job must use source=history (ZAP only supports type=yaml for the Sites Tree)

ci(dast): authenticated JWT scan (ZAP Automation Framework) + @WithMockEpuUser test support (#61)

* ci(dast): add authenticated JWT scan (ZAP Automation Framework) + reusable @WithMockEpuUser

DAST (Pipeline 4):
- add .zap/zap-jwt-config.yaml: Automation Framework plan with JWT context
  (json auth on /auth/login, header session management on data.accessToken,
  OpenAPI import from /v3/api-docs, spider + active scan with API policy,
  JSON/HTML/XML reports, exitStatus gate on High)
- pipeline-4-dast-scan: run the plan when DAST_STAGING_USER/PASS are set,
  degrade to the unauthenticated baseline scan otherwise, then gate on
  HIGH/CRITICAL alerts only and always upload the reports
- keep the fixes already landed on dev (chmod 777 for the ZAP container,
  relative report path, fail only on HIGH/CRITICAL)

Test support:
- add @WithMockEpuUser + WithMockEpuUserSecurityContextFactory so security
  aware tests can bootstrap a JwtUserPrincipal without a real JWT
- add factory test (3 cases)

* docs(dast): document the DAST staging account, RBAC limitation and login rate limit

* docs(dast): record verified root cause of the 500 responses and staging memory-quota risk
